jobs.description:
Absen Optoelectronic Co., Ltd., founded in 2001, is a global leader in LED display manufacturing, renowned for its innovation, reliability, and customer-centric approach. With over 3,000 employees worldwide, we provide cutting-edge LED display solutions across diverse industries.

Absen GmbH, founded in 2013, is the German subsidiary of the Absen Group, headquartered in Mörfelden-Walldorf near Frankfurt am Main. It directly manages the European market, coordinating all sales, service, and logistics activities across Europe, working closely with customers and partners, and ensuring that Absen’s high-quality standards are consistently met.

Technical Service Engineer – European Region 

(full-time, m/f/d)

Location: Mörfelden-Walldorf, Germany (near Frankfurt am Main)

Reporting to: European Service Manager

Role Overview

We are looking for a Technical Service Engineer to join our local service team in Germany and work closely with the European service organization.

Reporting to the European Service Manager, you will receive comprehensive onboarding training and ongoing business guidance to help you quickly gain an understanding of our products, customer service processes, and internal systems, enabling you to successfully integrate into the team and take ownership of your responsibilities.

Responsibilities

- Provide technical consultation, troubleshooting and solution support to customers and partners via phone, email, instant messaging and remote diagnostic tools.
- Diagnose and resolve LED display hardware and software issues remotely and on-site. Prepare detailed fault analysis and service reports.
- Act as the technical point of contact for end customers, system integrators and channel partners across Europe, handling technical inquiries, service requests and escalations.
- Travel across Europe to customer sites as required to provide installation guidance, commissioning, maintenance and repair support, ensuring successful project acceptance and delivery.
- Provide technical training to customers and partners on product operation, routine maintenance, system commissioning, troubleshooting and LED module repair.
- Coordinate with internal teams to ensure timely resolution of customer issues and contribute to continuous improvements in service quality and customer satisfaction.

Qualification

- Technical education or vocational training in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Telecommunications, or a related field; a bachelor’s degree or above is a plus.
- Relevant professional experience in technical service, field service, or a related technical role. Experience in the LED display or AV industry is a strong advantage.
- Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
- Fluent English required; German proficiency is a plus, with Chinese proficiency also considered an advantage.
- Strong customer-oriented mindset with excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
- Willingness to travel extensively across Europe, approximately 50%–70%, and ability to work independently on customer-facing on-site assignments.
- Detail-oriented, well-organized, and capable of working with a structured and systematic approach.

What We Offer

- A supportive, collaborative, and international working environment.
- A flat organizational structure with efficient and open communication.
- A competitive compensation package.
- Comprehensive onboarding and continuous professional development opportunities.
- 30 days of paid annual leave per year.
- Flexible working hours.
- Travel allowances and comprehensive support for business trips.
- Birthday and Christmas benefits.
- Free coffee and beverages in the office.
- Free parking.

We look forward to welcoming you to the Absen family!

Please send your complete application to: wlong@absen-europe.com (https://mailto:wlong@absen-europe.com) .

jobs.occupation: Account Manager Powerwall, Frankfurt am Main, Germany (m/w/d) (Account-Manager/in)
jobs.description:
What to Expect

Tesla is seeking an Account Manager for residential energy sales in Germany. Your core responsibility is B2B sales of Tesla residential and small commercial energy products, with a primary focus on Powerwall 3P — Tesla’s three-phase home battery and integrated inverter, purpose-built for the German and European grid. Following the launch of Powerwall 3P in Germany, you will scale adoption through distributors and third-party installers, grow a high-performing partner network, and drive business development in your region. We are looking for an experienced commercial professional with a background in PV or energy storage. Beyond strong execution and a team-oriented mindset, successful candidates bring creativity, passion, and the drive to lead in a fast-moving technology and market landscape. * This position can be based anywhere in Germany.

What You’ll Do

- Achieve Powerwall 3P and Wall Connector sales targets within assigned channel(s) in Germany
- Build and grow relationships across partner organizations (distributors, installers, and related channels), clearly communicating Tesla’s product portfolio, three-phase value proposition, and feature roadmap
- Drive partner readiness and ramp for Powerwall 3P: onboarding, enablement, pipeline building, and conversion from interest to installed systems
- Evaluate new business opportunities with existing and new accounts and/or sales channels, match suitable product offerings (including Powerwall 3P for three-phase residential and small commercial sites), and own capture of those opportunities
- Deliver market insights to the broader business — including competitive dynamics, installer feedback, and adoption barriers/opportunities specific to three-phase storage in Germany
- Provide accurate sales forecasts to business and manufacturing teams, reflecting Powerwall 3P ramp and channel mix
- Support assessment of market dynamics across sectors (utility, C&I, residential) and drivers (policy/regulatory, economics, grid requirements, incentive programs)
- Represent Tesla at sales and marketing events promoting Powerwall and Powerwall 3P
- Identify and support initiatives that improve partner training, installation quality, fulfilment, and Tesla support — with particular focus on three-phase design, commissioning, and backup use cases
- Provide user and customer feedback to IT on Tesla tools/systems and to Operations on processes

What You’ll Bring

- 5+ years in account management or channel sales within the PV or energy storage industry
- Strong understanding of residential/small commercial energy storage, ideally including three-phase (3P) systems, hybrid inverters, and grid-tied architectures common in Germany
- Working knowledge of grid/utility markets, grid connection practices, and relevant German/EU regulatory and incentive frameworks
- Excellent communication and documentation skills
- Ability to prioritize and run multiple projects and partner workstreams in parallel
- Fluency in English and German
- Flexibility to travel within Germany (and occasionally the broader region)

Tesla is an Equal Opportunity / Affirmative Action employer committed to diversity in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, gender identity or any other factor protected by applicable federal, state or local laws.

Tesla is also committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities. Please let your recruiter know if you need an accommodation at any point during the interview process.

Are you ready to start your career as an Aircraft Test Engineer (d/f/m)? This role works directly with state-of-the-art aviation systems. Located in Finkenwerder, you'll join a team tasked with providing Ground Test Instructions (GTIs) and Re-Test Instructions (RTIs) for the A320 family, across sites in Hamburg, Tianjin, and Alabama. Your efforts will directly support progress in the aerospace industry, helping ensure that modifications and functional tests are carried out to the highest standards. In a full-time position, you’ll take on a complex role that combines engineering creativity with operational excellence.

- You will plan and develop functional tests, such as GTIs and RTIs, using construction documents and Ground Test Requirements (GTR).
- You will take part in cross-border coordination and assess whether GTR content is feasible.
- You will track modifications and verify their effect on both existing and newly created GTIs.
- You will make sure GTR is fully applied in aircraft-specific GTIs.
- You will give direct assistance during function test execution and resolve issues in aircraft and test systems.
- You will play a key role in developing and enhancing testing tools and facilities.
- You will plan, carry out, and oversee projects aimed at lowering function test costs.
- You will help improve the test system specifications after any aircraft modifications.
- Drawing on your expertise, you will contribute to solving critical issues, including resolutions related to Ground Test Instructions up to Rejected Take-Off (RTO).
VORAUSSSETZUNGEN:

If you are eager to take on a demanding and technical position in the aviation sector, this role could be ideal for you. To be successful, you will need a solid background in engineering, technical documentation, and troubleshooting within complex aerospace or electronic systems. The qualifications and skills needed for this position are listed below:

- Minimum Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a comparable technical discipline.
- Minimum 2-3 years of professional experience in aviation, electronics, engineering, or technical documentation.
- Proficiency with tools such as SAP, Taksy/Gesy/Tesy, and zamiz, as well as familiarity with Google Workspace environments.
- Strong technical knowledge of communication and information systems, with more than three years of experience.
- Fluent in English (advanced working proficiency) and German (proficiency).
- Proven ability to understand and assess complex technical designs and workflows.
- A proactive, organized, and results-driven approach to project management and teamwork.
- Excellent communication skills to work effectively across all levels of an organization.
- Willingness to travel internationally 1-2 times per year and occasionally be available on-call.
Benefits:

This full-time role comes with a competitive, well-rounded benefits package aimed at helping you thrive professionally while keeping a healthy balance between work and personal life. Main benefits include:

- An open-ended employment contract for greater job security.
- A 35-hour working week to support work-life balance.
- 30 days of paid annual leave to rest and recover.
- An annual salary based on an appealing Equal Pay model.
- Flexibility for additional hours, either as compensatory time off or financial compensation.
